objects.name: totals
variables: It sums the amount of only the paid orders, for each region.
It returns one row for each region with a total.
The object `rows` shows fewer than 600 rows.
The object `totals` returns the totals without an error.
notes: Feed ends at 600 rows. A column can be renamed without notice. If totals fails, rebuild the filter (status=paid) and the aggregate (sum amount by region) with the new column names.
